_description.summary: World and casting environment: light level, ambit checks, device, circle and staff environment reflections, current dimension, Media Wave position and speed, Compass and Clock behaviour in the dimension.
use_cases: Checking light level or whether a location is in ambit
Checking how the hex is being cast (device, staff, circle)
Reading the current dimension or wave state

light_level.d: Removes a position vector from the stack and returns the light level at that position.

env_ambit.d: Pushes whether a location or entity is in ambit.

env_packaged_hex.d: Pushes whether any form of casting device is being used to cast this pattern.

env_circle.d: Pushes whether some form of *grand work* is being used to cast this pattern.

get_dimension.d: Pushes the identifier of the dimension the Hex is being cast in.

get_einstein.d: Pushes whether Compasses and Clocks will work in this dimension.
